title: CWP/19806/2025 of M/S SUNIL KUMAR CONTRACTOR Vs STATE OF PUNJAB AND ORS
text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF PUNJAB AND HARYANA AT CHANDIGARH (113) CWP-19806-2025 Date of decision:- 02.09.2025 M/S Sunil Kumar Contractor ...Petitioner Versus The State of Punjab and others ...Respondents CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SUVIR SEHGAL Present:- Mr. Ankur Gupta, Advocate (through VC) for the petitioner. Mr. Siddharth Sandhu, Assistant Advocate General, Punjab. … SUVIR SEHGAL, J. (Oral)

1. Pursuant to the previous order passed by this Court, State counsel has produced a xerox copy of Memo No.1279, dated 22.08.2025, to submit that the legal notice dated 14.05.2025, served by the petitioner, has been decided and it has been found that final payment of Rs.12,12,825/-, is due to the petitioner, which is to be received from the Punjab Mandi Board. Upon instructions from Mr. Pardeep Kumar, Executive Engineer (Construction), Division No.1, PWD (B&R), Ludhiana, he submits that the amount shall be released to the petitioner within a period of eight weeks.

2. Counsel for the petitioner is satisfied with the statement made by the State counsel.

3. In view of above, writ petition is disposed of. (SUVIR SEHGAL) 02.09.2025 JUDGE Pardeep PARDEEP NAUTIYAL authenticity of this order/judgment
